decks.notes: This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on fast and aggressive plays, prioritizing creatures with haste and burn spells to quickly chip away at the opponent's life total. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra level of consistency to the deck. By pressuring the opponent early and maintaining a strong board presence, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The mana base is finely tuned to provide the necessary colors for spells while ensuring a smooth curve of plays.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield, overwhelming opponents with fast and aggressive plays. It includes efficient cantrips and card draw spells to cycle through the deck, while also utilizing removal and counter spells to control the board. The deck also features a large number of mana sources to ensure consistent casting of spells and utilizes powerful finishers like Hall of Storm Giants and Treasure Cruise to close out games.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent early with aggressive creatures and disruption spells. The key strategy is to efficiently remove threats with removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while attacking with creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester. Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord provides additional support by buffing creatures and enabling additional plays. The deck aims to close out games quickly by overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive spells.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal, card draw, and utilizing powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria. By disrupting the opponent's game plan, generating card advantage, and protecting key threats, this UW Control deck aims to outlast and outsmart the opponent. With a mix of versatile spells and a solid mana base, along with win conditions like Castle Ardenvale and Shark Typhoon, this deck excels at grinding out victories and maintaining control of the game until it can secure a decisive advantage.

The deck focuses on using efficient creatures and combat tricks to deal damage quickly and aggressively to the opponent. It includes cards like Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Questing Druid to apply pressure early in the game. With spells like Atarka's Command, Monstrous Rage, and Play with Fire, the deck can burn out opponents and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck's game plan.

This Mono Black Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand and resources while gaining advantage with cards like Waste Not and Geier Reach Sanitarium. With a mix of removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to control the game and grind out victories through attrition. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Liliana of the Veil helps to maintain control over the tempo of the game, while cards like Castle Locthwain provide card advantage to stay ahead in the long game.

This aggressive deck focuses on dealing direct damage to the opponent quickly through a combination of low-cost creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply pressure early with efficient creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Ghitu Lavarunner, while maintaining a steady stream of damage with spells like Skewer the Critics and Play with Fire. The deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot and outpace them before they can establish a strong defense or gain control of the game.

The main idea of this aggressive Weenie White deck is to swarm the board with low-cost creatures like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Coppercoat Vanguard, buff them up with Thalia's Lieutenant, and protect them using cards like Brave the Elements and Dauntless Bodyguard. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of creatures and combat tricks, utilizing powerful cards like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Kytheon, Hero of Akros to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent. By playing aggressive, efficient creatures and maximizing synergy between cards, this deck seeks to win the game quickly through relentless attacking.

Utilizing a wide range of multicolored cards and the Niv-Mizzet Reborn legendary dragon, this Control deck focuses on versatile and flexible plays to outvalue opponents. By casting spells of different colors, players can trigger Niv-Mizzet Reborn's powerful ability to draw cards and gain card advantage. With the addition of cards like Bring to Light and Leyline Binding, this deck aims to control the game tempo and dominate the battlefield by utilizing a diverse array of spells and creatures to overwhelm the opponent.

The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures and using combat tricks and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. It also utilizes the Companion mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value. The creatures in the deck have abilities that help push through damage and the lands allow for consistent mana production to support the aggressive game plan. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early pressure and efficient removal spells to secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively enhance artifacts with cards like Ensoul Artifact and All That Glitters to create powerful threats on the board. With cards like Zoetic Glyph and Metallic Rebuke for protection and disruption, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of evasive creatures and efficient spells. The mix of artifact creatures like Ornithopter and utility creatures like Thraben Inspector provide a solid foundation for this aggressive strategy in the Pioneer format.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures like Vein Ripper and Bloodtithe Harvester, supported by removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Thoughtseize and Duress are used to control the opponent's hand, while cards like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional value and synergy. The deck aims to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, overwhelming them with threats while disrupting their strategy.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly build up a board presence and apply continuous pressure on the opponent. By playing efficient artifact creatures like Voldaren Epicure and Spyglass Siren, combined with powerful artifact spells like Ensoul Artifact and Shrapnel Blast, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent early in the game. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional versatility and mana fixing. Overall, the strategy revolves around aggressive plays and leveraging the synergy between artifacts to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on using creatures with abilities that gain life or create tokens to generate a large amount of life while maintaining a board presence. The key strategy is to assemble a combo involving Aetherflux Reservoir to gain a substantial amount of life and then use it as a win condition to deal lethal damage to the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Collected Company and Chord of Calling to search for key creatures and combo pieces, creating a versatile and resilient gameplay.

This Rakdos Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures and removal spells. The deck focuses on using cards like Bloodtithe Harvester, Vein Ripper, and Reckoner Bankbuster to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Sorin, Imperious Bloodlord adds another dimension to the deck's strategy, providing additional threats and card advantage. Overall, this deck prioritizes speed and disruption to quickly defeat the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the combo potential of Amalia Benavides Aguirre alongside cards like Chord of Calling and Collected Company to build a powerful board presence and gain life through cards like Prosperous Innkeeper and Wildgrowth Walker. The deck also includes various utility creatures like Skyclave Apparition and Selfless Savior to protect key pieces of the combo. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Return to the Ranks and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to ensure resilience and consistency in executing the combo strategy.
